name: Exp_FineTuningMACandle_Duplex
summary: This EA implements a dual Moving Average candle-based trend following strategy with fine-tuning capabilities. It generates trade signals when MA candles indicate directional shifts, opening positions in the direction of the emerging trend. The duplex architecture allows simultaneous long and short signal processing for more responsive market participation.
summary_zh: 该EA实现了基于双均线K线的趋势跟踪策略，具备精细调参功能。当均线K线指示方向性转变时产生交易信号，沿新兴趋势方向开仓。双工架构允许同时处理多头和空头信号，实现更灵敏的市场参与。
strategy_analysis: 该EA采用移动平均线构建的K线形态来判断趋势方向，核心概念是通过MA值的开高低收形成虚拟K线来过滤市场噪音。入场条件基于MA K线的颜色变化或形态突破，当均线K线由阴转阳时做多，由阳转阴时做空。出场条件依赖反向信号出现或固定止损止盈设置，部分版本可能包含移动止损功能。仓位管理支持固定手数和基于资金的动态计算两种模式。资金管理方面提供了风险百分比参数，但具体实现需要查看源码确认是否包含最大持仓限制或回撤控制。双工（Duplex）设计意味着EA可以同时跟踪两个不同参数集的均线信号，增加策略灵活性。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA uses candlestick patterns constructed from Moving Average values to determine trend direction, with the core concept being the creation of virtual candles from MA open/high/low/close values to filter market noise. Entry conditions are based on MA candle color changes or pattern breakouts - going long when MA candles shift from bearish to bullish, and going short when they shift from bullish to bearish. Exit conditions rely on the appearance of reversal signals or fixed stop-loss/take-profit settings, with some versions potentially including trailing stop functionality. Position sizing supports both fixed lot size and equity-based dynamic calculation modes. Money management provides risk percentage parameters, though the specific implementation details regarding maximum position limits or drawdown controls would need source code verification. The Duplex design means the EA can simultaneously track two different parameter sets of MA signals, increasing strategy flexibility.

pros: 双工架构允许同时监控两组不同参数的均线信号，提高策略适应性
基于均线K线形态的信号生成方式有效过滤短期价格噪音
支持精细调参，交易者可以优化不同市场环境下的参数组合
pros_en: Duplex architecture allows simultaneous monitoring of two different MA parameter sets, improving strategy adaptability
MA candle-based signal generation effectively filters short-term price noise
Fine-tuning support enables traders to optimize parameter combinations for different market conditions
cons: 趋势跟踪策略在震荡市中容易产生频繁虚假信号导致连续亏损
默认止损止盈为0存在极大资金风险，用户可能忽略设置
缺乏对市场波动率（ATR）的自适应机制，固定参数在不同波动环境下表现差异大
cons_en: Trend following strategy prone to frequent false signals and consecutive losses in ranging markets
Default stop-loss and take-profit of 0 poses significant capital risk if users neglect to set them
Lack of ATR-based volatility adaptation means fixed parameters perform inconsistently across varying volatility environments
improvements: 增加基于ATR的动态止损止盈计算，使风险管理适应市场波动率变化
添加震荡/趋势市场识别过滤器（如ADX），在震荡市中减少开仓频率
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic stop-loss and take-profit calculation to adapt risk management to market volatility changes
Add trend/range market identification filter (e.g., ADX) to reduce trade frequency in ranging markets

risk_points: 默认止损止盈参数为0，若用户未手动设置则仓位无保护
趋势策略在震荡市中可能连续亏损，缺乏行情状态过滤机制
risk_points_en: Default stop-loss and take-profit parameters are 0, leaving positions unprotected if users don't manually configure them
Trend strategy may incur consecutive losses in ranging markets due to lack of market state filtering mechanism
